statement: Ordered free OpenRouter models HPI may use per research task. Defaults are set from HPI's held-out evaluation, never from model size or marketing descriptions. Only ':free' variants verified as zero-priced in a fresh catalogue are ever sent requests; there is no paid fallback.

router.reason: Selects a free model at random per request: results are not reproducible, the model cannot be evaluated in advance, and data-policy compatibility of the chosen model cannot be checked before sending. The served model is recorded when a router is used, but HPI research runs do not use it.

evaluation.caveat: Defaults rest on 46 held-out items per model scored against HPI's own curated reference (not independent review). Small samples; revisit when the catalogue or prompts change.

evaluatedNotSelected.reason: Followed the embedded instruction in the evasive injection item once (output passed automated validation; only human review would catch it); mechanism-tagging precision 0/1; 7 provider errors in 45 requests.
Not evaluable: 6 of 6 requests were rate-limited upstream (shared free pool); the remaining items were not sent.
Selected only as fallback: the only ZDR-listed free text model; zero citation failures and correct abstention, but 25% claim-extraction provider failures and weaker contradiction judgements (2/6).
